key_insight: VoroTypes automatically enumerates all Voronoi cell topologies for a crystal under small perturbations, enabling structural identification of complex crystals beyond simple reference lattices.
engineering_relevance: It turns crystallographic input files into reusable topological filters for VoroTop and OVITO, improving atomistic phase identification in molecular simulations.
method: Takes CIF or POSCAR crystal descriptions as input.
Uses exact symmetry reduction and validity pruning to speed up enumeration.
Exports per-sublattice Voronoi topology filters for direct use in VoroTop.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a precomputed library covering over a thousand structures from the Materials Project, indicating broad applicability and scale.
watch_item: The method depends on accurate crystallographic input and small generic perturbations, so unusual distortions or noisy structures may reduce reliability.
paper_title: VoroTypes: automated enumeration of Voronoi cell topologies for structural identification of complex crystals in atomistic simulations
